existingLanguage: eligible recurring bot pull requests are merged and provably superseded ones are closed, each with GitHub receipts
question: Do GitHub receipts require posted pickup/verification/pre-close comment receipts as gating preconditions, or may those comment WRITES be best effort while durable independent verification, pre-close justification and authentic API effect evidence remain mandatory?

options.retain_comment_preconditions: Require the existing posted comment/trail prerequisites; missing receipts refuse the operation.
options.ratify_best_effort_comment_writes: Explicitly ratify best-effort GitHub comment writes, never substitutes for durable independent verification, pre-close justification, authentic effect evidence, required fail-closed reads or other protection gates.

implementationHold: F1/F2 technical repairs do not settle this ruling. Do not change ratified authority, receipt gates or tests under the guise of the technical repair.
